items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: But Ivie Anderson, we got her in Chicago.

ctx.x: Oh, she was wonderful; she was She was a hell of a gambler-- wonderful. A She used to keep some of the boys broke, she was good in gambling, and in poker. She stayed day and there at night gambling; it didn't make any difference to her.
How about Duke's taste in singers? I mean the singers he'd pick; Ivy le you liked very much -- but did you like all of the singers that he picked?
